verdict.rationale: Jina Reader's own GitHub docs say PDFs and MS Office documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) can be POSTed directly via the `file` body field with no need to host them first. That matches the story exactly, and it is backed by native PDF support and a bundled LibreOffice in the image. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of file-upload extraction, and in-depth docs on per-format extraction quality, size limits and edge cases.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can extract text content from PDFs, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without hosting them myself
